meta.status: Primary QB comparison · separate from the NFL forecast
meta.rookieInitializationSource: FiveThirtyEight historical NFL QB VALUE methodology and game ledger
meta.regressionPolicy: Once per offseason for 10–100 career starts after 10+ prior-season starts or when named the opening starter
meta.baselinePolicy: Each season uses the previous season's mean EPA performance Elo
meta.healthyBenchPolicy: Every regular-season healthy rostered non-starter can decay when above the line; injury-report weeks are excluded; reserve statuses are excluded; the line uses QB2s only; total decay is capped at 50% of the opening gap; the spell carries across offseasons until three starts establish a new decay anchor
meta.qb2BaselinePolicy: Previous season's mean pregame EPA QB Elo among healthy players listed second at quarterback
meta.source: nflverse weekly player statistics; passing_epa uses nflfastR qb_epa
meta.method: Opponent-adjusted passing EPA per dropback, standardized within season, with draft initialization and conditional offseason regression
